sources.title: Sheltron — Open Models for AI Safety
sources.snippet: A 400M-parameter sequence-pair classifier that checks whether an agent's answer or action still preserves the user's original intent — catching unsafe intent drift at the output boundary, after the model has decided what to do.

sources.title: Johns Hopkins' Ettin Proves Smaller Encoders Beat Larger Decoders on ...
sources.snippet: Johns Hopkins and LightOn released Ettin, ten paired encoder and decoder models from 17M to 1B parameters. Both architectures share identical data, shape, and recipe, differing only in attention and training objective.
